summary_for_children: An-Nazi'at tells of Musa called in the valley of Tuwa and sent to Pharaoh, and shows how Allah raised the sky and spread the earth.
world_title: The Valley of Tuwa Called Again
environment_concept: A high open place under a wide raised sky (79:28), a spring bubbling out of the ground into a green pasture (79:31), and mountains set firmly around the valley (79:32). The story of Musa and Pharaoh (79:15-26) is told only in the reading, not shown, and the Day of 79:34-46 is not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A sky platform, a spring and pasture, firm mountains around the valley.
